agentContract.successRule: success is true only when actions complete and final postconditions pass
agentContract.driftRule: hash drift is diagnostic and does not fail a command by itself
agentContract.fallbackRule: use fallback recording when no listed command fits or an invoked command fails
agentContract.acquisitionFallbackRule: browser acquisition fallback must go through cg use/cg shell or cartographer pw; raw CDP, standalone Playwright scripts, and separate browsers are external escape hatches and do not satisfy acquisition review
agentContract.learningRule: if fallback is used, end-task review is required and every reusable fallback should be promoted into a CLI command
agentContract.selectorRule: selectors may be snapshot refs, CSS, XPath, or Cartographer Playwright locator forms
agentContract.taskBrowserRule: when --task-id is passed, acquired CLI commands and cartographer pw commands attach to a Cartographer-owned browser using the site default profile; complete-task closes the browser session
agentContract.loginWaitRule: if Instagram shows a login screen, Cartographer pauses for human login and resumes after Enter
agentContract.fallbackSessionRule: a failed shell/cartographer pw selector/action is recoverable inside the same task browser; retry with a better selector instead of starting another task. prefer cg use for multi-operation work because it keeps a hot recorded Playwright CLI session attached
agentContract.segmentJournalRule: active fallback segments write events.jsonl; cartographer pw commands are fallback evidence, acquired CLI commands run with the same taskId are journaled as non-promotable context
agentContract.promotionEligibilityRule: review may use all journal events as context, but promotion ignores events with promotionEligible:false
agentContract.promotionReplayRule: apply-promotion-decision replays non-write/no-arg promotions in the task browser before catalog mutation; write-capable promotions are not auto-replayed
agentContract.scriptedFallbackRule: recorded fallback uses shell commands or cartographer pw <playwright-cli-command>; review-task materializes active pw journals into fallback tapes
agentContract.stateScopeRule: commands may declare stateScope; Cartographer checks preconditions before execution and returns precondition_failed with suggestedAutoEnterProcessName/fallbackRecommended when unmet

taskLifecycle.taskFileRule: begin-task persists task.json immediately; cartographer pw --task-id appends segment.json files under that task
taskLifecycle.noAcquisitionCloseRule: if fallback segments exist but no acquisition packet was saved, completion requires an explicit no-acquisition reason

promotionPolicy.name: v1
enforced: command name must be snake_case and unique
fallback tape must have succeeded and must not already be promoted
promotion must identify at least one recorded step or exact operationIndexes for an operation slice
description must explicitly describe what the command does
write commands are write-protected if the tape or any step writes
if stateScope is present, it must declare at least one precondition
stateScope.autoEnterProcessName must point to an existing non-write command
runtime placeholders must have declared args
output contracts must have valid names, selectors, and descriptions
if duplicate candidates are surfaced, promotion requires explicit duplicateJudgment
advisory: the agent is responsible for deciding whether the tape is semantically generic and reusable
the agent is responsible for deciding whether surfaced duplicate candidates already cover the fallback capability
evaluate operation slices independently; noisy sibling operations do not disqualify clean slices
promotion-ready candidate slices should be promoted or explicitly rejected before rejecting the whole fallback
prefer deterministic browser/evidence commands over semantic workflow commands
prefer selector-backed textual outputs over screenshots for read/evidence commands
non-write commands without outputs are navigation/state commands only
state-scoped commands should expose the narrow state they require; global commands should omit stateScope
prefer rejecting a broad task fallback and promoting only a smaller reusable sub-operation

promotionDecisionWorkflow.agentInstruction: For task review, reason over review-request.json, start from decision-template.json, and return one PromotionBatchDecision JSON. Decide promotion-ready slices independently before rejecting the remaining whole fallback.
promotionDecisionWorkflow.afterPromotion: Treat agentContractDelta from the apply result as an immediate patch to the working command contract. Use reusableCommand.command, or refresh SKILL.md/manifest.json, to reuse the acquired CLI skill.
